messages.text:
"Create a 3D third-person action-adventure game with vibrant, cel-shaded graphics set in a vast flooded world. The player controls a young, expressive hero exploring an open ocean on a small, cartoonish sailboat. Instead of traditional swords and magic, the core combat revolves around heavy ballistic weapons. The hero is armed with machine guns, assault rifles, and dual SMGs.
Gameplay includes sailing between colorful islands, exploring puzzle-filled dungeons, and engaging in fast-paced, run-and-gun combat with lock-on targeting and dodge-rolling. Enemies are quirky, cartoonish monsters that drop ammo and loot when defeated. The overall vibe is a hilarious contrast between wholesome, cozy ocean exploration and over-the-top, chaotic firefights.
"
